audit_metadata.skip_reason: Services offline at audit time (static-mode only)

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read & Remote Code Execution
escalations.description: vitest 2.0.5 (GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp): Vitest UI server exposes arbitrary file read and code execution with no authentication. Network-accessible on any dev machine with --ui flag active.

escalations.title: form-data CRLF Injection via Multipart Field Names
escalations.description: form-data 4.0.5 (GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx): Multipart field names and filenames not escaped for CRLF; enables HTTP header injection when untrusted filenames are passed to multipart uploads.

escalations.title: Vite Path Traversal & server.fs.deny Bypass
escalations.description: vite 5.4.0 (GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9, GHSA-v6wh-96g9-6wx3, GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff): Dev server can be made to serve files outside the intended root; Windows UNC paths bypass server.fs.deny; source map information disclosure.

escalations.title: PostCSS XSS via Unescaped </style> in CSS Output
escalations.description: postcss <8.5.10 (GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93): Unescaped </style> sequences in CSS output allow breaking out of style context and injecting arbitrary HTML/JS.

p1_findings.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read & Remote Code Execution
p1_findings.description: When Vitest UI server is listening (dev mode), arbitrary files can be read and executed via network request. No authentication required.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker on the same network opens browser to http://dev-machine:51204/__vitest_api__/read?path=../../../../.env to read environment secrets, or executes arbitrary code.
p1_findings.impact: Full developer workstation compromise; environment secret exfiltration; supply chain attack vector.
p1_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm install vitest@^3.2.6 --save-dev (also requires vite >=8.1.0)

p1_findings.title: Minizlib Uncontrolled Resource Consumption (DoS)
p1_findings.description: Specially crafted compressed data triggers uncontrolled CPU and memory consumption. Affects npm install and package resolution.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker provides a malicious .tgz to any flow that calls npm install (CI/CD, developer onboarding); exhausts memory/CPU causing DoS.
p1_findings.impact: CI/CD pipeline DoS; developer environment instability during dependency installation.
p1_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix --audit-level=critical in Source/Backend (may require clean install).

p2_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Covers Only 11% of Requirements
p2_findings.description: Enforcer reads only the most-recently-modified requirements.md (Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md, 13 FRs). Never checks Plans/dev-workflow-platform/, Plans/orchestrated-dev-cycles/, or 5 other plans. Reports PASSED with 11% visibility.
p2_findings.recommendation: Modify enforcer to iterate all Plans/*/requirements.md files. Add portal/ and platform/ to scan paths.

p2_findings.title: Portal Routes Call getDb() Directly — 51 Occurrences, 9 Files
p2_findings.description: CLAUDE.md rule: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.' Every portal route handler calls const db = getDb() and passes it into service functions (51 occurrences). DB lifecycle is controlled by the HTTP layer, not the service layer.
p2_findings.recommendation: Move getDb() calls into each service function. Route handlers should call listBugs({ status, severity }) with no db argument.

p2_findings.title: FR-090 to FR-095 Implemented Without Spec Entries
p2_findings.description: FR-090 through FR-095 (orchestrator run-detail UI) have // Verifies: comments in portal code but no corresponding requirements.md entry exists. Violates spec-first rule.
p2_findings.recommendation: Write Plans/orchestrator-run-detail/requirements.md defining FR-090 through FR-095, then run traceability enforcer.

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF Injection via Multipart Field Names
p2_findings.description: Multipart field names and filenames not escaped for CRLF characters; allows HTTP header injection if untrusted filenames passed directly.

p2_findings.title: Vite Path Traversal & Windows Alternate Path Bypass
p2_findings.description: Dev server can be tricked to serve files outside the intended root. Windows UNC paths bypass server.fs.deny. Source map disclosure.

p2_findings.title: ws WebSocket Memory Exhaustion DoS
p2_findings.description: Memory exhaustion from tiny WebSocket fragments. Attacker crafts malformed frames to exhaust server memory. Affects dev servers using ws (HMR, live reload).
p2_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix (upgrades ws transitively via parent package updates).

p2_findings.title: UUID Missing Buffer Bounds Check (Buffer Overflow)
p2_findings.description: Missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf parameter is provided; can corrupt adjacent memory.
